scene.name: papers/c4_paddle_return

task.name: papers
task.sentence: Return the balls the ball machine lobs over the net with the paddle held in the right hand, onto the far half of the table.
task.protocol: 10 balls, one at a time: the machine lobs the next once the last is decided, then stops
task.pass_rule: at least 7 of the 10 balls returned (touched by the paddle, then their first bounce on the far half)

scene.description: Sprout behind the near end of a small table-tennis table, a paddle on a stand at its right hand; a ball machine at the far end lobs balls at it once the paddle is lifted -- return them over the net. Aids -- the closed jaws latch the paddle's handle; the robot's real-time lane follows the balls with an external tracker (the privileged snapshot).
